unidentified_name: Humming stone in a rune-cut cage
benefit: Always points toward the nearest Votann machine-spirit. (+1 Wits when scanning ancient tech, once equipping is built.)
drawback: It hums louder near Orks. They can hear it too.

benefit: An ancestor machine-spirit of terrible power, and it seems to like you. (Its effects arrive with relic equipping.)
drawback: Every League in the Reach wants it, and some of them will ask nicely.
